definitions.explanation: The underlying support or groundwork for something, whether physical (like a building) or abstract (like knowledge or skills).

examples.japanese: {基礎|きそ}からしっかり{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: To learn thoroughly from the basics.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{基礎|きそ}がしっかりしている。
examples.english: This building has a solid foundation.

examples.japanese: {基礎|きそ}{体力|たいりょく}を{つける。
examples.english: To build up basic physical fitness.

notes:
USAGE: Used both literally (building foundations) and figuratively (basic knowledge, fundamental skills).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{基礎|きそ}{知識|ちしき} (basic knowledge)
・{基礎|きそ}{体力|たいりょく} (basic physical fitness)
・{基礎|きそ}{工事|こうじ} (foundation work)
・{基礎|きそ}{研究|けんきゅう} (basic research)
・{基礎|きそ}{英語|えいご} (basic English)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{土台|どだい} - foundation (more physical/concrete)
・{基本|きほん} - basics, fundamentals (more about principles)
・{基盤|きばん} - base, foundation (often for systems/organizations)
